name: @art-pollinator/transport-ble
description: TransportPort implementation over BLE GATT (issue #33), using react-native-ble-plx's Central-role read/write/notify. See README.md for scope (Central-role only this batch) and docs/adr/0010-hybrid-foreground-first-ble-swap-model.md / docs/adr/0011-ble-peripheral-advertising-library.md for why. NOT wired to a real react-native-ble-plx here — this package depends only on @art-pollinator/core; the real native module is a peer dependency supplied by the composition root that constructs BleTransportAdapter, so this package itself never becomes a native-only import (AGENTS.md §5).
